Ginger Cookies Recipe
Cream 3/4 soften butter
then add 1 cup brown sugar, cream together
beat in 1 egg, and 1/4 cup molasses
Sift in 2-1/4 cup flour, 2 tsp ground ginger, 2 tsp cinnamon, 2 tsp ground cloves, 1 tsp baking soda, 1/4 tsp salt

Roll into balls and coat with sugar. Do not flatten. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 min. Take out and let cool on pan.

videos.title: Doing Gel Nails at Home!
videos.description:
Here is a link to everything you will need to do Gel Nails at Home: https://amzn.to/40rJRpV
Doing Gel Nails at Home:
-file nails, push back cuticles, wash hands and clean nail bed with alcohol wipe.
-apply base coat, and cure in light for 60 sec
-apply color coat, and cure for 90 sec, repeat however many coats you want or need
-apply top coat, cure in light for 90 sec
-wipe off tacky layer with alcohol wipe
-apply nail oil

If you do your own nails, please tag me on IG

videos.title: No Cruise For You. Why We Couldn't Go.
videos.description:
This was such a weird day. It really felt like a blur and as I tried to document it I dont feel like I captured how the day truly was. It felt like we were in shock a little. I know that sounds dramatic and that was part of our mixed emotions. We travel a lot and so I felt like I didnt have the right to be sad, since there are so many other worse things in the world, ya know. 
I think I felt the most bad for my Dad. He was so excited to go, and it was our last trip before they leave on a mission

Add in 1 tsp salt, 1&1/12 tsp baking powder, and 5&1/2 c. flour, mix.

Blanket Time is a simple concept to getting your kids to listen.

Place a Blanket on the floor, have your toddler sit with a few toys and they do not get off until MOM says. 
Doing this on a regular basis anywhere from 10 min - 1 hr will help your kids with their ability to focus, lengthen their attention span, self entertain,and teach them to listen to their parents!
